summary: Give a selected object enough screen space to explain its parts without losing its identity in the scene.
objective: Select a small object in the overview, isolate it, select an internal part and return; identity and camera context remain coherent.
example_prompts: Give a selected object enough screen space to explain its parts without losing its identity in the scene.

principles: Inspection is an alternate presentation of the selected object, not evidence that the object is correct.
Retain a compact orientation cue or return view so a detail still has a place in the whole.
implementation: Save camera target, distance and scene visibility before isolating a stable object ID. Fit the entire assembly including open-door or extended-limb bounds.
Offer part selection and a neutral backdrop; keep active lighting changes explicit so material comparisons remain meaningful.
If using layers, configure both camera and picking filters. Include lights and helpers intentionally rather than assuming they follow the selected mesh.
observable_checks: Select a small object in the overview, isolate it, select an internal part and return; identity and camera context remain coherent.
Isolation does not advance a paused simulation or reset its state unexpectedly.

known_limits: Visibility isolation does not prove structural or physical correctness and may conceal environment contacts.
Authored reusable guidance; no runtime artifact or improvement has been observed for this record.
creative_affordances: Adapt proportions, finish and presentation to the scene; explain deliberate departures from this guidance.

claims.statement: Object3D layers can filter camera visibility and ray-intersection tests.
claims.scope: Visibility/picking mechanism; the inspection workflow is authored.
